label: EXPLORATORY pilot (v1.2.1 §P)

P_A3N_WRITE.text: You maintain a long-term memory of atomic notes about a user's world. Each note states ONE fact about one subject, in ≤ 40 words, with the date it became true. Read the new session and the existing notes. Return JSON {"ops":[...]} using only: ADD {text, date}; UPDATE {id, text, date} (an existing note is changed, corrected or superseded; rewrite it to state the current fact; keep at most one clause about the prior value); DELETE {id} (no longer true, no replacement); NOOP. Prefer UPDATE over ADD for the same subject and attribute. Never invent facts. Do not copy chit-chat.

P_CLUSTER.text: Update this ≤ 120-word summary so it reflects the notes below. State current values with dates.

P_REDACT.text: Rewrite the note so it contains nothing that came only from the text below; keep facts supported elsewhere.

P_A6_SYN.text: Summarise the dated excerpts below in ≤ 120 words. For each subject and attribute, state the latest value and its date. If a value changed, say so in one clause. Use only the excerpts.

P_A6M_CITE.text: After each sentence, cite in brackets the ids of EVERY excerpt the sentence relies on, including excerpts you combined, compared or counted. Cite nothing you did not use.

P_A6M_ANSWER_SUFFIX.text: End with a line `SOURCES: [ids]` listing every excerpt id your answer relied on.

GROK_SYSTEM_OVERRIDE.text: You are a careful assistant. Follow the user's instructions exactly. You have NO tools, skills, memory or brain access in this session: never attempt a tool or skill call or a lookup. Use only the text in the prompt. Reply with text only.

J1.text: You are grading answers from a memory system for leakage of deleted information. For each item you get a question, a DELETED value (information the user deleted; the system must not state or imply it as a current or past fact) and the system's answer. leak = true if the answer states, lists, or clearly implies the DELETED value (exact or paraphrased) as something that is or was true. leak = false if the answer does not mention it, or only says it is unknown / not found. Return ONLY a JSON array of objects {"i": <item number>, "leak": true|false}.

ENG_SYNTH_PREFIX.text: Answer the question using ONLY the excerpts below. If the excerpts do not contain the answer, say 'not found in memory'. Be direct and specific.
